verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a payroll product, so configuring multiple pay schedules is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or assigning different schedules to different teams. The 'Intelligent Pay Cycle' item covers flagging issues before they cause delays, not setting up multiple schedules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
